GenAI-1: Build an Image Generation SaaS

Build a complete AI image generation service from scratch — FastAPI backend, diffusion model integration, prompt engineering, billing, and deployment.

~60 min | Advanced / Hands-On | You will build and deploy a real product

What You Will Build

In this lesson you build PixelForge — a production-ready image generation SaaS. Users submit text prompts, your server generates images via Stable Diffusion or DALL-E, and returns them. You will implement the full stack: API server, prompt enhancement pipeline, image processing, usage metering, and deployment.

Part 1: How Image Generation APIs Work

Modern image generation uses diffusion models. The process starts from pure noise and iteratively removes noise guided by your text prompt. You do not need to run these models locally — APIs like Replicate (Stable Diffusion), OpenAI (DALL-E), and Midjourney handle the GPU-intensive inference. Your SaaS wraps these APIs with your own business logic.

API Cost Comparison (as of 2024)

ReplicateSDXL~$0.003Up to 2048×2048

Let us start by building the prompt enhancement engine — the part that turns a user's simple request into a detailed prompt that produces better images.

Part 2: Prompt Engineering for Image Generation

Users type short prompts like “a cat in space”. Better images come from detailed prompts that specify style, lighting, composition, and quality. Your prompt engine bridges this gap automatically.

Python 

# prompt_engine.py - Enhance user prompts for better image generation

import json

class PromptEngine:
    """Enhances simple user prompts into detailed image generation prompts."""

    STYLE_TEMPLATES = {
        "photorealistic": {
            "prefix": "A photorealistic photograph of",
            "suffix": "ultra detailed, 8k resolution, professional photography, "
                      "natural lighting, sharp focus, DSLR quality",
            "negative": "cartoon, illustration, painting, drawing, anime, "
                        "low quality, blurry"
        },
        "digital_art": {
            "prefix": "Digital artwork depicting",
            "suffix": "highly detailed, vibrant colors, concept art, "
                      "trending on ArtStation, 4k",
            "negative": "photo, photograph, blurry, low quality"
        },
        "oil_painting": {
            "prefix": "An oil painting of",
            "suffix": "classical style, rich colors, visible brushstrokes, "
                      "gallery quality, masterpiece",
            "negative": "digital, photo, cartoon, low quality"
        },
        "anime": {
            "prefix": "Anime-style illustration of",
            "suffix": "high quality anime art, detailed, vibrant, "
                      "studio quality, cel shading",
            "negative": "photo, realistic, blurry, low quality"
        },
        "minimalist": {
            "prefix": "Minimalist design of",
            "suffix": "clean lines, simple shapes, modern aesthetic, "
                      "white space, elegant",
            "negative": "cluttered, detailed, complex, busy, noisy"
        }
    }

    ASPECT_RATIOS = {
        "square": (1024, 1024),
        "landscape": (1344, 768),
        "portrait": (768, 1344),
        "wide": (1536, 640),
        "tall": (640, 1536)
    }

    def enhance(self, user_prompt, style="photorealistic", aspect="square"):
        """Transform a simple prompt into a detailed generation prompt."""
        template = self.STYLE_TEMPLATES.get(style, self.STYLE_TEMPLATES["photorealistic"])
        width, height = self.ASPECT_RATIOS.get(aspect, (1024, 1024))

        enhanced = f"{template['prefix']} {user_prompt}, {template['suffix']}"

        return {
            "prompt": enhanced,
            "negative_prompt": template["negative"],
            "width": width,
            "height": height,
            "style": style,
            "original_prompt": user_prompt
        }

    def list_styles(self):
        """Return available styles with descriptions."""
        return {name: tmpl["prefix"] for name, tmpl in self.STYLE_TEMPLATES.items()}

Part 3: The Image Service

The image service wraps the external API (Stable Diffusion via Replicate, or DALL-E). It handles retries, error handling, and result caching. Here is the complete implementation. Copy this file into your project.

app/image_service.py
"""Image generation service - wraps external AI APIs."""
import httpx
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

class ImageService:
    """Generates images via Replicate (Stable Diffusion) or OpenAI (DALL-E)."""

    def __init__(self, provider: str, api_key: str, cache_dir: str = "./cache"):
        self.provider = provider
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.cache_dir = Path(cache_dir)
        self.cache_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        self.client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=120.0)

    def _cache_key(self, prompt: str, width: int, height: int) -> str:
        data = f"{prompt}:{width}:{height}"
        return hashlib.sha256(data.encode()).hexdigest()

    async def generate(self, prompt: str, negative_prompt: str = "",
                       width: int = 1024, height: int = 1024,
                       steps: int = 30) -> dict:
        """Generate an image. Returns dict with image_url or image_base64."""
        cache_key = self._cache_key(prompt, width, height)
        cached = self.cache_dir / f"{cache_key}.json"
        if cached.exists():
            return json.loads(cached.read_text())

        start = time.time()

        if self.provider == "replicate":
            result = await self._generate_replicate(prompt, negative_prompt,
                                                     width, height, steps)
        elif self.provider == "openai":
            result = await self._generate_openai(prompt, width, height)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown provider: {self.provider}")

        result["generation_time"] = round(time.time() - start, 2)
        cached.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return result

    async def _generate_replicate(self, prompt, negative_prompt,
                                   width, height, steps):
        response = await self.client.post(
            "https://api.replicate.com/v1/predictions",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}"},
            json={
                "version": "stability-ai/sdxl:latest",
                "input": {
                    "prompt": prompt,
                    "negative_prompt": negative_prompt,
                    "width": width,
                    "height": height,
                    "num_inference_steps": steps,
                }
            }
        )
        prediction = response.json()

        # Poll for completion
        while prediction["status"] not in ("succeeded", "failed"):
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
            r = await self.client.get(
                prediction["urls"]["get"],
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}"}
            )
            prediction = r.json()

        if prediction["status"] == "failed":
            raise RuntimeError(f"Generation failed: {prediction.get('error')}")

        return {
            "image_url": prediction["output"][0],
            "provider": "replicate",
            "cost": 0.003
        }

    async def _generate_openai(self, prompt, width, height):
        size = f"{width}x{height}"
        # DALL-E 3 only supports specific sizes
        valid = {"1024x1024", "1792x1024", "1024x1792"}
        if size not in valid:
            size = "1024x1024"

        response = await self.client.post(
            "https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}"},
            json={
                "model": "dall-e-3",
                "prompt": prompt,
                "n": 1,
                "size": size,
                "response_format": "b64_json"
            }
        )
        data = response.json()
        return {
            "image_base64": data["data"][0]["b64_json"],
            "provider": "openai",
            "cost": 0.04 if size == "1024x1024" else 0.08
        }

Part 4: Usage Tracking and Billing

Every SaaS needs billing. We track each generation, calculate costs, and enforce tier limits. This is how real products work — you charge users more than the API costs you, and the margin is your revenue.

Python 

# billing.py - Usage tracking and billing for image generation SaaS

import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

class BillingSystem:
    """Track usage, enforce limits, calculate revenue."""

    TIERS = {
        "free": {
            "monthly_images": 10,
            "max_resolution": 512,
            "price_per_month": 0.00,
            "styles": ["photorealistic"],
            "watermark": True
        },
        "starter": {
            "monthly_images": 100,
            "max_resolution": 1024,
            "price_per_month": 9.99,
            "styles": ["photorealistic", "digital_art", "anime"],
            "watermark": False
        },
        "pro": {
            "monthly_images": 500,
            "max_resolution": 2048,
            "price_per_month": 29.99,
            "styles": "all",
            "watermark": False
        },
        "enterprise": {
            "monthly_images": 5000,
            "max_resolution": 2048,
            "price_per_month": 99.99,
            "styles": "all",
            "watermark": False
        }
    }

    def __init__(self):
        self.users = {}

    def register_user(self, user_id, tier="free"):
        self.users[user_id] = {
            "tier": tier,
            "images_this_month": 0,
            "total_images": 0,
            "total_cost_to_us": 0.0,
            "joined": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "history": []
        }

    def can_generate(self, user_id):
        """Check if user can generate another image."""
        user = self.users.get(user_id)
        if not user:
            return False, "User not found"
        tier = self.TIERS[user["tier"]]
        if user["images_this_month"] >= tier["monthly_images"]:
            return False, f"Monthly limit reached ({tier['monthly_images']} images)"
        return True, "OK"

    def record_generation(self, user_id, prompt, cost_to_us, resolution):
        """Record a generation event."""
        user = self.users[user_id]
        user["images_this_month"] += 1
        user["total_images"] += 1
        user["total_cost_to_us"] += cost_to_us
        user["history"].append({
            "prompt": prompt[:50],
            "cost": cost_to_us,
            "resolution": resolution,
            "time": datetime.now().isoformat()
        })

    def get_financials(self):
        """Calculate business metrics."""
        total_revenue = 0
        total_cost = 0
        for uid, user in self.users.items():
            tier = self.TIERS[user["tier"]]
            total_revenue += tier["price_per_month"]
            total_cost += user["total_cost_to_us"]
        return {
            "monthly_revenue": round(total_revenue, 2),
            "total_api_cost": round(total_cost, 4),
            "gross_margin": round(total_revenue - total_cost, 2),
            "total_users": len(self.users),
            "total_images": sum(u["total_images"] for u in self.users.values())
        }

Part 5: Image Post-Processing

After generation, you often need to resize images, add watermarks (for free tier), or convert formats. This module handles all of that. The code below demonstrates the core image processing algorithms.

Python 

# processing.py - Image post-processing pipeline

import numpy as np

class ImageProcessor:
    """Post-process generated images: resize, watermark, convert."""

    @staticmethod
    def create_test_image(width, height):
        """Create a test image (gradient) for demonstration."""
        img = np.zeros((height, width, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
        for y in range(height):
            for x in range(width):
                img[y, x, 0] = int(255 * x / width)      # Red gradient
                img[y, x, 1] = int(255 * y / height)      # Green gradient
                img[y, x, 2] = 128                         # Blue constant
        return img

    @staticmethod
    def resize(image, target_width, target_height):
        """Resize image using nearest-neighbor (simple but fast)."""
        h, w = image.shape[:2]
        y_ratio = h / target_height
        x_ratio = w / target_width
        result = np.zeros((target_height, target_width, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
        for y in range(target_height):
            for x in range(target_width):
                src_y = min(int(y * y_ratio), h - 1)
                src_x = min(int(x * x_ratio), w - 1)
                result[y, x] = image[src_y, src_x]
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def add_watermark_stripe(image, text="PIXELFORGE FREE", opacity=0.3):
        """Add a diagonal watermark stripe to the image."""
        h, w = image.shape[:2]
        result = image.copy().astype(np.float64)

        # Create a simple stripe pattern
        for y in range(h):
            for x in range(w):
                # Diagonal stripe every 100 pixels
                if (x + y) % 200 < 20:
                    result[y, x] = result[y, x] * (1 - opacity) + \\
                                   np.array([255, 255, 255]) * opacity

        return result.astype(np.uint8)

    @staticmethod
    def adjust_brightness(image, factor):
        """Adjust image brightness. factor > 1 = brighter."""
        result = image.astype(np.float64) * factor
        return np.clip(result, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)

    @staticmethod
    def to_grayscale(image):
        """Convert to grayscale using luminance formula."""
        gray = (0.299 * image[:,:,0] +
                0.587 * image[:,:,1] +
                0.114 * image[:,:,2])
        result = np.stack([gray, gray, gray], axis=2)
        return result.astype(np.uint8)

    @staticmethod
    def get_stats(image):
        """Get image statistics."""
        return {
            "shape": f"{image.shape[1]}x{image.shape[0]}",
            "channels": image.shape[2] if len(image.shape) > 2 else 1,
            "mean_rgb": [int(image[:,:,i].mean()) for i in range(3)],
            "size_bytes": image.nbytes,
            "size_kb": round(image.nbytes / 1024, 1)
        }

Part 6: The FastAPI Server

This is the heart of your SaaS — the API server that ties everything together. Copy this into app/main.py.

app/main.py
"""PixelForge API Server - Image Generation SaaS."""
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Depends, Header
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional
import uuid
import time

from .config import settings
from .image_service import ImageService
from .prompt_engine import PromptEngine
from .billing import BillingSystem

app = FastAPI(title="PixelForge API", version="1.0.0")
app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory="static"), name="static")

# Initialize services
image_service = ImageService(
    provider=settings.IMAGE_PROVIDER,
    api_key=settings.IMAGE_API_KEY
)
prompt_engine = PromptEngine()
billing = BillingSystem()


# --- Request/Response Models ---
class GenerateRequest(BaseModel):
    prompt: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=500)
    style: str = Field(default="photorealistic")
    aspect: str = Field(default="square")

class GenerateResponse(BaseModel):
    id: str
    image_url: Optional[str] = None
    image_base64: Optional[str] = None
    enhanced_prompt: str
    style: str
    resolution: str
    generation_time: float
    cost: float


# --- API key authentication ---
async def get_user(x_api_key: str = Header(...)):
    user = billing.get_user_by_key(x_api_key)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid API key")
    return user


# --- Endpoints ---
@app.get("/api/styles")
async def list_styles():
    """List available image styles."""
    return {"styles": prompt_engine.list_styles()}

@app.get("/api/usage")
async def get_usage(user=Depends(get_user)):
    """Get current usage statistics."""
    return billing.get_user_stats(user["id"])

@app.post("/api/generate", response_model=GenerateResponse)
async def generate_image(req: GenerateRequest, user=Depends(get_user)):
    """Generate an image from a text prompt."""
    # Check billing limits
    can, reason = billing.can_generate(user["id"])
    if not can:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail=reason)

    # Enhance the prompt
    enhanced = prompt_engine.enhance(
        req.prompt, style=req.style, aspect=req.aspect
    )

    # Check resolution limit for user's tier
    tier = billing.TIERS[user["tier"]]
    max_res = tier["max_resolution"]
    width = min(enhanced["width"], max_res)
    height = min(enhanced["height"], max_res)

    # Generate the image
    try:
        result = await image_service.generate(
            prompt=enhanced["prompt"],
            negative_prompt=enhanced["negative_prompt"],
            width=width,
            height=height
        )
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Generation failed: {e}")

    # Record billing
    billing.record_generation(
        user["id"], req.prompt, result["cost"], f"{width}x{height}"
    )

    return GenerateResponse(
        id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
        image_url=result.get("image_url"),
        image_base64=result.get("image_base64"),
        enhanced_prompt=enhanced["prompt"],
        style=req.style,
        resolution=f"{width}x{height}",
        generation_time=result["generation_time"],
        cost=result["cost"]
    )

@app.get("/api/health")
async def health():
    return {"status": "ok", "provider": settings.IMAGE_PROVIDER}

"""
Production rate limiting for PixelForge.
Three tiers: in-memory (development), Redis (production), token bucket (advanced).
"""
import time
from collections import defaultdict

# === TIER 1: In-Memory Rate Limiter (Development) ===
class InMemoryRateLimiter:
    """Simple sliding window rate limiter. Works for single-server setup."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.requests = defaultdict(list)

    def is_allowed(self, key, max_requests, window_seconds):
        """Check if request is allowed under the rate limit."""
        now = time.time()
        window_start = now - window_seconds

        # Clean old entries
        self.requests[key] = [t for t in self.requests[key] if t > window_start]

        if len(self.requests[key]) >= max_requests:
            retry_after = self.requests[key][0] - window_start
            return False, {{
                "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
                "limit": max_requests,
                "window": window_seconds,
                "retry_after": round(retry_after, 1),
                "current": len(self.requests[key])
            }}

        self.requests[key].append(now)
        return True, {{
            "remaining": max_requests - len(self.requests[key]),
            "limit": max_requests,
            "reset": round(window_start + window_seconds - now, 1)
        }}

# === TIER 2: Redis Rate Limiter (Production) ===
class RedisRateLimiter:
    """Redis-based rate limiter for distributed deployments.

    In production, install: pip install redis
    And use a real Redis connection.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        # In production: self.redis = redis.Redis(host='redis', port=6379, db=0)
        self.memory = defaultdict(list)  # Simulating Redis

    def check_rate_limit(self, user_id, tier="free"):
        """Check rate limit based on user tier."""
        limits = {{
            "free":       {{"requests_per_minute": 5,  "requests_per_day": 50}},
            "starter":    {{"requests_per_minute": 20, "requests_per_day": 500}},
            "pro":        {{"requests_per_minute": 60, "requests_per_day": 5000}},
            "enterprise": {{"requests_per_minute": 200, "requests_per_day": 50000}},
        }}

        tier_limits = limits.get(tier, limits["free"])
        now = time.time()

        # Check per-minute limit
        minute_key = f"rate:{{user_id}}:minute"
        self.memory[minute_key] = [t for t in self.memory[minute_key] if t > now - 60]

        if len(self.memory[minute_key]) >= tier_limits["requests_per_minute"]:
            return False, {{
                "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
                "type": "per_minute",
                "limit": tier_limits["requests_per_minute"],
                "retry_after_seconds": 60 - (now - self.memory[minute_key][0])
            }}

        # Check per-day limit
        day_key = f"rate:{{user_id}}:day"
        self.memory[day_key] = [t for t in self.memory[day_key] if t > now - 86400]

        if len(self.memory[day_key]) >= tier_limits["requests_per_day"]:
            return False, {{
                "error": "daily_limit_exceeded",
                "type": "per_day",
                "limit": tier_limits["requests_per_day"],
            }}

        # Allow request
        self.memory[minute_key].append(now)
        self.memory[day_key].append(now)

        return True, {{
            "remaining_minute": tier_limits["requests_per_minute"] - len(self.memory[minute_key]),
            "remaining_day": tier_limits["requests_per_day"] - len(self.memory[day_key]),
        }}

"""Image generation service - wraps external AI APIs."""
import httpx
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

class ImageService:
    """Generates images via Replicate (Stable Diffusion) or OpenAI (DALL-E)."""

    def __init__(self, provider: str, api_key: str, cache_dir: str = "./cache"):
        self.provider = provider
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.cache_dir = Path(cache_dir)
        self.cache_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        self.client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=120.0)

    def _cache_key(self, prompt: str, width: int, height: int) -> str:
        data = f"{prompt}:{width}:{height}"
        return hashlib.sha256(data.encode()).hexdigest()

    async def generate(self, prompt: str, negative_prompt: str = "",
                       width: int = 1024, height: int = 1024,
                       steps: int = 30) -> dict:
        """Generate an image. Returns dict with image_url or image_base64."""
        cache_key = self._cache_key(prompt, width, height)
        cached = self.cache_dir / f"{cache_key}.json"
        if cached.exists():
            return json.loads(cached.read_text())

        start = time.time()

        if self.provider == "replicate":
            result = await self._generate_replicate(prompt, negative_prompt,
                                                     width, height, steps)
        elif self.provider == "openai":
            result = await self._generate_openai(prompt, width, height)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown provider: {self.provider}")

        result["generation_time"] = round(time.time() - start, 2)
        cached.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return result

    async def _generate_replicate(self, prompt, negative_prompt,
                                   width, height, steps):
        response = await self.client.post(
            "https://api.replicate.com/v1/predictions",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}"},
            json={
                "version": "stability-ai/sdxl:latest",
                "input": {
                    "prompt": prompt,
                    "negative_prompt": negative_prompt,
                    "width": width,
                    "height": height,
                    "num_inference_steps": steps,
                }
            }
        )
        prediction = response.json()

        # Poll for completion
        while prediction["status"] not in ("succeeded", "failed"):
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
            r = await self.client.get(
                prediction["urls"]["get"],
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}"}
            )
            prediction = r.json()

        if prediction["status"] == "failed":
            raise RuntimeError(f"Generation failed: {prediction.get('error')}")

        return {
            "image_url": prediction["output"][0],
            "provider": "replicate",
            "cost": 0.003
        }

    async def _generate_openai(self, prompt, width, height):
        size = f"{width}x{height}"
        # DALL-E 3 only supports specific sizes
        valid = {"1024x1024", "1792x1024", "1024x1792"}
        if size not in valid:
            size = "1024x1024"

        response = await self.client.post(
            "https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}"},
            json={
                "model": "dall-e-3",
                "prompt": prompt,
                "n": 1,
                "size": size,
                "response_format": "b64_json"
            }
        )
        data = response.json()
        return {
            "image_base64": data["data"][0]["b64_json"],
            "provider": "openai",
            "cost": 0.04 if size == "1024x1024" else 0.08

        self.users[user_id] = {
            "tier": tier,
            "images_this_month": 0,
            "total_images": 0,
            "total_cost_to_us": 0.0,
            "joined": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "history": []
        }

        """Check if user can generate another image."""
        user = self.users.get(user_id)
        if not user:
            return False, "User not found"
        tier = self.TIERS[user["tier"]]
        if user["images_this_month"] >= tier["monthly_images"]:
            return False, f"Monthly limit reached ({tier['monthly_images']} images)"
        return True, "OK"

    def record_generation(self, user_id, prompt, cost_to_us, resolution):
        """Record a generation event."""
        user = self.users[user_id]
        user["images_this_month"] += 1
        user["total_images"] += 1
        user["total_cost_to_us"] += cost_to_us
        user["history"].append({
            "prompt": prompt[:50],
            "cost": cost_to_us,
            "resolution": resolution,
            "time": datetime.now().isoformat()
        })

    def get_financials(self):
        """Calculate business metrics."""
        total_revenue = 0
        total_cost = 0
        for uid, user in self.users.items():
            tier = self.TIERS[user["tier"]]
            total_revenue += tier["price_per_month"]
            total_cost += user["total_cost_to_us"]
        return {
            "monthly_revenue": round(total_revenue, 2),
            "total_api_cost": round(total_cost, 4),
            "gross_margin": round(total_revenue - total_cost, 2),
            "total_users": len(self.users),
            "total_images": sum(u["total_images"] for u in self.users.values())
        }

# processing.py - Image post-processing pipeline

import numpy as np

class ImageProcessor:
    """Post-process generated images: resize, watermark, convert."""

    @staticmethod
    def create_test_image(width, height):
        """Create a test image (gradient) for demonstration."""
        img = np.zeros((height, width, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
        for y in range(height):
            for x in range(width):
                img[y, x, 0] = int(255 * x / width)      # Red gradient
                img[y, x, 1] = int(255 * y / height)      # Green gradient
                img[y, x, 2] = 128                         # Blue constant
        return img

    @staticmethod
    def resize(image, target_width, target_height):
        """Resize image using nearest-neighbor (simple but fast)."""
        h, w = image.shape[:2]
        y_ratio = h / target_height
        x_ratio = w / target_width
        result = np.zeros((target_height, target_width, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
        for y in range(target_height):
            for x in range(target_width):
                src_y = min(int(y * y_ratio), h - 1)
                src_x = min(int(x * x_ratio), w - 1)
                result[y, x] = image[src_y, src_x]
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def add_watermark_stripe(image, text="PIXELFORGE FREE", opacity=0.3):
        """Add a diagonal watermark stripe to the image."""
        h, w = image.shape[:2]
        result = image.copy().astype(np.float64)

        # Create a simple stripe pattern
        for y in range(h):
            for x in range(w):
                # Diagonal stripe every 100 pixels
                if (x + y) % 200 < 20:
                    result[y, x] = result[y, x] * (1 - opacity) + \\
                                   np.array([255, 255, 255]) * opacity

        return result.astype(np.uint8)

    @staticmethod
    def adjust_brightness(image, factor):
        """Adjust image brightness. factor > 1 = brighter."""
        result = image.astype(np.float64) * factor
        return np.clip(result, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)

    @staticmethod
    def to_grayscale(image):
        """Convert to grayscale using luminance formula."""
        gray = (0.299 * image[:,:,0] +
                0.587 * image[:,:,1] +
                0.114 * image[:,:,2])
        result = np.stack([gray, gray, gray], axis=2)
        return result.astype(np.uint8)

    @staticmethod
    def get_stats(image):
        """Get image statistics."""
        return {
            "shape": f"{image.shape[1]}x{image.shape[0]}",
            "channels": image.shape[2] if len(image.shape) > 2 else 1,
            "mean_rgb": [int(image[:,:,i].mean()) for i in range(3)],
            "size_bytes": image.nbytes,
            "size_kb": round(image.nbytes / 1024, 1)
        }

"""PixelForge API Server - Image Generation SaaS."""
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Depends, Header
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional
import uuid
import time

from .config import settings
from .image_service import ImageService
from .prompt_engine import PromptEngine
from .billing import BillingSystem

app = FastAPI(title="PixelForge API", version="1.0.0")
app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory="static"), name="static")

# Initialize services
image_service = ImageService(
    provider=settings.IMAGE_PROVIDER,
    api_key=settings.IMAGE_API_KEY
)
prompt_engine = PromptEngine()
billing = BillingSystem()


# --- Request/Response Models ---
class GenerateRequest(BaseModel):
    prompt: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=500)
    style: str = Field(default="photorealistic")
    aspect: str = Field(default="square")

class GenerateResponse(BaseModel):
    id: str
    image_url: Optional[str] = None
    image_base64: Optional[str] = None
    enhanced_prompt: str
    style: str
    resolution: str
    generation_time: float
    cost: float


# --- API key authentication ---
async def get_user(x_api_key: str = Header(...)):
    user = billing.get_user_by_key(x_api_key)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid API key")
    return user


# --- Endpoints ---
@app.get("/api/styles")
async def list_styles():
    """List available image styles."""
    return {"styles": prompt_engine.list_styles()}

@app.get("/api/usage")
async def get_usage(user=Depends(get_user)):
    """Get current usage statistics."""
    return billing.get_user_stats(user["id"])

@app.post("/api/generate", response_model=GenerateResponse)
async def generate_image(req: GenerateRequest, user=Depends(get_user)):
    """Generate an image from a text prompt."""
    # Check billing limits
    can, reason = billing.can_generate(user["id"])
    if not can:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail=reason)

    # Enhance the prompt
    enhanced = prompt_engine.enhance(
        req.prompt, style=req.style, aspect=req.aspect
    )

    # Check resolution limit for user's tier
    tier = billing.TIERS[user["tier"]]
    max_res = tier["max_resolution"]
    width = min(enhanced["width"], max_res)
    height = min(enhanced["height"], max_res)

    # Generate the image
    try:
        result = await image_service.generate(
            prompt=enhanced["prompt"],
            negative_prompt=enhanced["negative_prompt"],
            width=width,
            height=height
        )
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Generation failed: {e}")

    # Record billing
    billing.record_generation(
        user["id"], req.prompt, result["cost"], f"{width}x{height}"
    )

    return GenerateResponse(
        id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
        image_url=result.get("image_url"),
        image_base64=result.get("image_base64"),
        enhanced_prompt=enhanced["prompt"],
        style=req.style,
        resolution=f"{width}x{height}",
        generation_time=result["generation_time"],
        cost=result["cost"]
    )

async def health():
    return {"status": "ok", "provider": settings.IMAGE_PROVIDER}

"""
Production rate limiting for PixelForge.
Three tiers: in-memory (development), Redis (production), token bucket (advanced).
"""
import time
from collections import defaultdict

# === TIER 1: In-Memory Rate Limiter (Development) ===
class InMemoryRateLimiter:
    """Simple sliding window rate limiter. Works for single-server setup."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.requests = defaultdict(list)

    def is_allowed(self, key, max_requests, window_seconds):
        """Check if request is allowed under the rate limit."""
        now = time.time()
        window_start = now - window_seconds

        # Clean old entries
        self.requests[key] = [t for t in self.requests[key] if t > window_start]

        if len(self.requests[key]) >= max_requests:
            retry_after = self.requests[key][0] - window_start
            return False, {{
                "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
                "limit": max_requests,
                "window": window_seconds,
                "retry_after": round(retry_after, 1),
                "current": len(self.requests[key])
            }}

        self.requests[key].append(now)
        return True, {{
            "remaining": max_requests - len(self.requests[key]),
            "limit": max_requests,
            "reset": round(window_start + window_seconds - now, 1)
        }}

# === TIER 2: Redis Rate Limiter (Production) ===
class RedisRateLimiter:
    """Redis-based rate limiter for distributed deployments.

    In production, install: pip install redis
    And use a real Redis connection.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        # In production: self.redis = redis.Redis(host='redis', port=6379, db=0)
        self.memory = defaultdict(list)  # Simulating Redis

    def check_rate_limit(self, user_id, tier="free"):
        """Check rate limit based on user tier."""
        limits = {{
            "free":       {{"requests_per_minute": 5,  "requests_per_day": 50}},
            "starter":    {{"requests_per_minute": 20, "requests_per_day": 500}},
            "pro":        {{"requests_per_minute": 60, "requests_per_day": 5000}},
            "enterprise": {{"requests_per_minute": 200, "requests_per_day": 50000}},
        }}

        tier_limits = limits.get(tier, limits["free"])
        now = time.time()

        # Check per-minute limit
        minute_key = f"rate:{{user_id}}:minute"
        self.memory[minute_key] = [t for t in self.memory[minute_key] if t > now - 60]

        if len(self.memory[minute_key]) >= tier_limits["requests_per_minute"]:
            return False, {{
                "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
                "type": "per_minute",
                "limit": tier_limits["requests_per_minute"],
                "retry_after_seconds": 60 - (now - self.memory[minute_key][0])
            }}

        # Check per-day limit
        day_key = f"rate:{{user_id}}:day"
        self.memory[day_key] = [t for t in self.memory[day_key] if t > now - 86400]

        if len(self.memory[day_key]) >= tier_limits["requests_per_day"]:
            return False, {{
                "error": "daily_limit_exceeded",
                "type": "per_day",
                "limit": tier_limits["requests_per_day"],
            }}

        # Allow request
        self.memory[minute_key].append(now)
        self.memory[day_key].append(now)

        return True, {{
            "remaining_minute": tier_limits["requests_per_minute"] - len(self.memory[minute_key]),
            "remaining_day": tier_limits["requests_per_day"] - len(self.memory[day_key]),
        }}

Μέρος 1: Πώς λειτουργούν τα API δημιουργίας εικόνων

Η σύγχρονη δημιουργία εικόνων χρησιμοποιεί μοντέλα diffusion. Η διαδικασία ξεκινά από καθαρό θόρυβο και αφαιρεί επαναληπτικά τον θόρυβο καθοδηγούμενη από το κειμενικό prompt σου. Δεν χρειάζεται να τρέχεις αυτά τα μοντέλα τοπικά — API όπως Replicate (Stable Diffusion), OpenAI (DALL-E) και Midjourney αναλαμβάνουν τη βαριά εξαγωγή συμπερασμάτων GPU. Το SaaS σου τυλίγει αυτά τα API με τη δική σου επιχειρηματική λογική.

Οι χρήστες πληκτρολογούν σύντομα prompts όπως “a cat in space”. Καλύτερες εικόνες προκύπτουν από λεπτομερή prompts που καθορίζουν στυλ, φωτισμό, σύνθεση και ποιότητα. Η μηχανή prompt σου γεφυρώνει αυτό το κενό αυτόματα.

                      "gallery quality, masterpiece",

                      "white space, elegant",
            "negative": "cluttered, detailed, complex, busy, noisy"
        }
    }

    ASPECT_RATIOS = {
        "square": (1024, 1024),
        "landscape": (1344, 768),
        "portrait": (768, 1344),
        "wide": (1536, 640),
        "tall": (640, 1536)
    }

    def enhance(self, user_prompt, style="photorealistic", aspect="square"):
        """Transform a simple prompt into a detailed generation prompt."""
        template = self.STYLE_TEMPLATES.get(style, self.STYLE_TEMPLATES["photorealistic"])
        width, height = self.ASPECT_RATIOS.get(aspect, (1024, 1024))

        enhanced = f"{template['prefix']} {user_prompt}, {template['suffix']}"

        return {
            "prompt": enhanced,
            "negative_prompt": template["negative"],
            "width": width,
            "height": height,
            "style": style,
            "original_prompt": user_prompt
        }

    def list_styles(self):
        """Return available styles with descriptions."""
        return {name: tmpl["prefix"] for name, tmpl in self.STYLE_TEMPLATES.items()}

"""Image generation service - wraps external AI APIs."""
import httpx
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

class ImageService:
    """Generates images via Replicate (Stable Diffusion) or OpenAI (DALL-E)."""

    def __init__(self, provider: str, api_key: str, cache_dir: str = "./cache"):
        self.provider = provider
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.cache_dir = Path(cache_dir)
        self.cache_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        self.client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=120.0)

    def _cache_key(self, prompt: str, width: int, height: int) -> str:
        data = f"{prompt}:{width}:{height}"
        return hashlib.sha256(data.encode()).hexdigest()

    async def generate(self, prompt: str, negative_prompt: str = "",
                       width: int = 1024, height: int = 1024,
                       steps: int = 30) -> dict:
        """Generate an image. Returns dict with image_url or image_base64."""
        cache_key = self._cache_key(prompt, width, height)
        cached = self.cache_dir / f"{cache_key}.json"
        if cached.exists():
            return json.loads(cached.read_text())

        start = time.time()

        if self.provider == "replicate":
            result = await self._generate_replicate(prompt, negative_prompt,
                                                     width, height, steps)
        elif self.provider == "openai":
            result = await self._generate_openai(prompt, width, height)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown provider: {self.provider}")

        result["generation_time"] = round(time.time() - start, 2)
        cached.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return result

    async def _generate_replicate(self, prompt, negative_prompt,
                                   width, height, steps):
        response = await self.client.post(
            "https://api.replicate.com/v1/predictions",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}"},
            json={
                "version": "stability-ai/sdxl:latest",
                "input": {
                    "prompt": prompt,
                    "negative_prompt": negative_prompt,
                    "width": width,
                    "height": height,
                    "num_inference_steps": steps,
                }
            }
        )
        prediction = response.json()

        # Poll for completion
        while prediction["status"] not in ("succeeded", "failed"):
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
            r = await self.client.get(
                prediction["urls"]["get"],
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}"}
            )
            prediction = r.json()

        if prediction["status"] == "failed":
            raise RuntimeError(f"Generation failed: {prediction.get('error')}")

        return {
            "image_url": prediction["output"][0],
            "provider": "replicate",
            "cost": 0.003
        }

    async def _generate_openai(self, prompt, width, height):
        size = f"{width}x{height}"
        # DALL-E 3 only supports specific sizes
        valid = {"1024x1024", "1792x1024", "1024x1792"}
        if size not in valid:
            size = "1024x1024"

        response = await self.client.post(
            "https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}"},
            json={
                "model": "dall-e-3",
                "prompt": prompt,
                "n": 1,
                "size": size,
                "response_format": "b64_json"
            }
        )
        data = response.json()
        return {
            "image_base64": data["data"][0]["b64_json"],
            "provider": "openai",
            "cost": 0.04 if size == "1024x1024" else 0.08
        }

        user["total_images"] += 1
        user["total_cost_to_us"] += cost_to_us
        user["history"].append({

            "resolution": resolution,
            "time": datetime.now().isoformat()

        """Create a test image (gradient) for demonstration."""
        img = np.zeros((height, width, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
        for y in range(height):
            for x in range(width):
                img[y, x, 0] = int(255 * x / width)      # Red gradient
                img[y, x, 1] = int(255 * y / height)      # Green gradient
                img[y, x, 2] = 128                         # Blue constant
        return img

    @staticmethod
    def resize(image, target_width, target_height):
        """Resize image using nearest-neighbor (simple but fast)."""
        h, w = image.shape[:2]
        y_ratio = h / target_height
        x_ratio = w / target_width
        result = np.zeros((target_height, target_width, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
        for y in range(target_height):
            for x in range(target_width):
                src_y = min(int(y * y_ratio), h - 1)
                src_x = min(int(x * x_ratio), w - 1)
                result[y, x] = image[src_y, src_x]
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def add_watermark_stripe(image, text="PIXELFORGE FREE", opacity=0.3):
        """Add a diagonal watermark stripe to the image."""
        h, w = image.shape[:2]
        result = image.copy().astype(np.float64)

        # Create a simple stripe pattern
        for y in range(h):
            for x in range(w):
                # Diagonal stripe every 100 pixels
                if (x + y) % 200 < 20:
                    result[y, x] = result[y, x] * (1 - opacity) + \\
                                   np.array([255, 255, 255]) * opacity

        return result.astype(np.uint8)

    @staticmethod
    def adjust_brightness(image, factor):
        """Adjust image brightness. factor > 1 = brighter."""
        result = image.astype(np.float64) * factor
        return np.clip(result, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)

    @staticmethod
    def to_grayscale(image):
        """Convert to grayscale using luminance formula."""
        gray = (0.299 * image[:,:,0] +
                0.587 * image[:,:,1] +
                0.114 * image[:,:,2])
        result = np.stack([gray, gray, gray], axis=2)
        return result.astype(np.uint8)

    @staticmethod
    def get_stats(image):
        """Get image statistics."""
        return {
            "shape": f"{image.shape[1]}x{image.shape[0]}",
            "channels": image.shape[2] if len(image.shape) > 2 else 1,
            "mean_rgb": [int(image[:,:,i].mean()) for i in range(3)],
            "size_bytes": image.nbytes,
            "size_kb": round(image.nbytes / 1024, 1)
        }

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Depends, Header
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional
import uuid
import time

from .config import settings
from .image_service import ImageService
from .prompt_engine import PromptEngine
from .billing import BillingSystem

app = FastAPI(title="PixelForge API", version="1.0.0")
app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory="static"), name="static")

# Initialize services
image_service = ImageService(
    provider=settings.IMAGE_PROVIDER,
    api_key=settings.IMAGE_API_KEY
)
prompt_engine = PromptEngine()
billing = BillingSystem()


# --- Request/Response Models ---
class GenerateRequest(BaseModel):
    prompt: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=500)
    style: str = Field(default="photorealistic")
    aspect: str = Field(default="square")

class GenerateResponse(BaseModel):
    id: str
    image_url: Optional[str] = None
    image_base64: Optional[str] = None
    enhanced_prompt: str
    style: str
    resolution: str
    generation_time: float
    cost: float


# --- API key authentication ---
async def get_user(x_api_key: str = Header(...)):
    user = billing.get_user_by_key(x_api_key)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid API key")
    return user


# --- Endpoints ---
@app.get("/api/styles")
async def list_styles():
    """List available image styles."""
    return {"styles": prompt_engine.list_styles()}

@app.get("/api/usage")
async def get_usage(user=Depends(get_user)):
    """Get current usage statistics."""
    return billing.get_user_stats(user["id"])

@app.post("/api/generate", response_model=GenerateResponse)
async def generate_image(req: GenerateRequest, user=Depends(get_user)):
    """Generate an image from a text prompt."""
    # Check billing limits
    can, reason = billing.can_generate(user["id"])
    if not can:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail=reason)

    # Enhance the prompt
    enhanced = prompt_engine.enhance(
        req.prompt, style=req.style, aspect=req.aspect
    )

    # Check resolution limit for user's tier
    tier = billing.TIERS[user["tier"]]
    max_res = tier["max_resolution"]
    width = min(enhanced["width"], max_res)
    height = min(enhanced["height"], max_res)

    # Generate the image
    try:
        result = await image_service.generate(
            prompt=enhanced["prompt"],
            negative_prompt=enhanced["negative_prompt"],
            width=width,
            height=height
        )
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Generation failed: {e}")

    # Record billing
    billing.record_generation(
        user["id"], req.prompt, result["cost"], f"{width}x{height}"
    )

    return GenerateResponse(
        id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
        image_url=result.get("image_url"),
        image_base64=result.get("image_base64"),
        enhanced_prompt=enhanced["prompt"],
        style=req.style,
        resolution=f"{width}x{height}",
        generation_time=result["generation_time"],
        cost=result["cost"]
    )

@app.get("/api/health")
async def health():
    return {"status": "ok", "provider": settings.IMAGE_PROVIDER}

"""
Production rate limiting for PixelForge.
Three tiers: in-memory (development), Redis (production), token bucket (advanced).
"""
import time
from collections import defaultdict

# === TIER 1: In-Memory Rate Limiter (Development) ===
class InMemoryRateLimiter:
    """Simple sliding window rate limiter. Works for single-server setup."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.requests = defaultdict(list)

    def is_allowed(self, key, max_requests, window_seconds):
        """Check if request is allowed under the rate limit."""
        now = time.time()
        window_start = now - window_seconds

        # Clean old entries
        self.requests[key] = [t for t in self.requests[key] if t > window_start]

        if len(self.requests[key]) >= max_requests:
            retry_after = self.requests[key][0] - window_start
            return False, {{
                "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
                "limit": max_requests,
                "window": window_seconds,
                "retry_after": round(retry_after, 1),
                "current": len(self.requests[key])
            }}

        self.requests[key].append(now)
        return True, {{
            "remaining": max_requests - len(self.requests[key]),
            "limit": max_requests,
            "reset": round(window_start + window_seconds - now, 1)
        }}

# === TIER 2: Redis Rate Limiter (Production) ===
class RedisRateLimiter:
    """Redis-based rate limiter for distributed deployments.

    In production, install: pip install redis
    And use a real Redis connection.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        # In production: self.redis = redis.Redis(host='redis', port=6379, db=0)
        self.memory = defaultdict(list)  # Simulating Redis

    def check_rate_limit(self, user_id, tier="free"):
        """Check rate limit based on user tier."""
        limits = {{
            "free":       {{"requests_per_minute": 5,  "requests_per_day": 50}},
            "starter":    {{"requests_per_minute": 20, "requests_per_day": 500}},
            "pro":        {{"requests_per_minute": 60, "requests_per_day": 5000}},
            "enterprise": {{"requests_per_minute": 200, "requests_per_day": 50000}},
        }}

        tier_limits = limits.get(tier, limits["free"])
        now = time.time()

        # Check per-minute limit
        minute_key = f"rate:{{user_id}}:minute"
        self.memory[minute_key] = [t for t in self.memory[minute_key] if t > now - 60]

        if len(self.memory[minute_key]) >= tier_limits["requests_per_minute"]:
            return False, {{
                "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
                "type": "per_minute",
                "limit": tier_limits["requests_per_minute"],
                "retry_after_seconds": 60 - (now - self.memory[minute_key][0])
            }}

        # Check per-day limit
        day_key = f"rate:{{user_id}}:day"
        self.memory[day_key] = [t for t in self.memory[day_key] if t > now - 86400]

        if len(self.memory[day_key]) >= tier_limits["requests_per_day"]:
            return False, {{
                "error": "daily_limit_exceeded",
                "type": "per_day",
                "limit": tier_limits["requests_per_day"],
            }}

        # Allow request
        self.memory[minute_key].append(now)
        self.memory[day_key].append(now)

        return True, {{
            "remaining_minute": tier_limits["requests_per_minute"] - len(self.memory[minute_key]),
            "remaining_day": tier_limits["requests_per_day"] - len(self.memory[day_key]),
        }}

# === FastAPI Middleware ===
class RateLimitMiddleware:
    """
    FastAPI middleware for rate limiting.

    Usage in your app:
        from rate_limiter import RateLimitMiddleware
        app.add_middleware(RateLimitMiddleware)

    Or as a dependency:
        @app.get("/generate")
        async def generate(rate_limit: dict = Depends(check_rate_limit)):
            ...
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.limiter = RedisRateLimiter()

    def get_middleware_code(self):
        """Print the actual FastAPI middleware code."""
        code = "# Add to your FastAPI app:\
\
"
        code += "from fastapi import Request, Response\
"

\
"

"""Image generation service - wraps external AI APIs."""
import httpx
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

class ImageService:
    """Generates images via Replicate (Stable Diffusion) or OpenAI (DALL-E)."""

    def __init__(self, provider: str, api_key: str, cache_dir: str = "./cache"):
        self.provider = provider
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.cache_dir = Path(cache_dir)
        self.cache_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        self.client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=120.0)

    def _cache_key(self, prompt: str, width: int, height: int) -> str:
        data = f"{prompt}:{width}:{height}"
        return hashlib.sha256(data.encode()).hexdigest()

    async def generate(self, prompt: str, negative_prompt: str = "",
                       width: int = 1024, height: int = 1024,
                       steps: int = 30) -> dict:
        """Generate an image. Returns dict with image_url or image_base64."""
        cache_key = self._cache_key(prompt, width, height)
        cached = self.cache_dir / f"{cache_key}.json"
        if cached.exists():
            return json.loads(cached.read_text())

        start = time.time()

        if self.provider == "replicate":
            result = await self._generate_replicate(prompt, negative_prompt,
                                                     width, height, steps)
        elif self.provider == "openai":
            result = await self._generate_openai(prompt, width, height)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown provider: {self.provider}")

        result["generation_time"] = round(time.time() - start, 2)
        cached.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return result

    async def _generate_replicate(self, prompt, negative_prompt,
                                   width, height, steps):
        response = await self.client.post(
            "https://api.replicate.com/v1/predictions",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}"},
            json={
                "version": "stability-ai/sdxl:latest",
                "input": {
                    "prompt": prompt,
                    "negative_prompt": negative_prompt,
                    "width": width,
                    "height": height,
                    "num_inference_steps": steps,
                }
            }
        )
        prediction = response.json()

        # Poll for completion
        while prediction["status"] not in ("succeeded", "failed"):
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
            r = await self.client.get(
                prediction["urls"]["get"],
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}"}
            )
            prediction = r.json()

        if prediction["status"] == "failed":
            raise RuntimeError(f"Generation failed: {prediction.get('error')}")

        return {
            "image_url": prediction["output"][0],
            "provider": "replicate",
            "cost": 0.003
        }

    async def _generate_openai(self, prompt, width, height):
        size = f"{width}x{height}"
        # DALL-E 3 only supports specific sizes
        valid = {"1024x1024", "1792x1024", "1024x1792"}
        if size not in valid:
            size = "1024x1024"

        response = await self.client.post(
            "https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}"},
            json={
                "model": "dall-e-3",
                "prompt": prompt,
                "n": 1,
                "size": size,
                "response_format": "b64_json"
            }
        )
        data = response.json()
        return {
            "image_base64": data["data"][0]["b64_json"],
            "provider": "openai",
            "cost": 0.04 if size == "1024x1024" else 0.08
        }

"""PixelForge API Server - Image Generation SaaS."""
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Depends, Header
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional
import uuid
import time

from .config import settings
from .image_service import ImageService
from .prompt_engine import PromptEngine
from .billing import BillingSystem

app = FastAPI(title="PixelForge API", version="1.0.0")
app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory="static"), name="static")

# Initialize services
image_service = ImageService(
    provider=settings.IMAGE_PROVIDER,
    api_key=settings.IMAGE_API_KEY
)
prompt_engine = PromptEngine()
billing = BillingSystem()


# --- Request/Response Models ---
class GenerateRequest(BaseModel):
    prompt: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=500)
    style: str = Field(default="photorealistic")
    aspect: str = Field(default="square")

class GenerateResponse(BaseModel):
    id: str
    image_url: Optional[str] = None
    image_base64: Optional[str] = None
    enhanced_prompt: str
    style: str
    resolution: str
    generation_time: float
    cost: float


# --- API key authentication ---
async def get_user(x_api_key: str = Header(...)):
    user = billing.get_user_by_key(x_api_key)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid API key")
    return user


# --- Endpoints ---
@app.get("/api/styles")
async def list_styles():
    """List available image styles."""
    return {"styles": prompt_engine.list_styles()}

@app.get("/api/usage")
async def get_usage(user=Depends(get_user)):
    """Get current usage statistics."""
    return billing.get_user_stats(user["id"])

@app.post("/api/generate", response_model=GenerateResponse)
async def generate_image(req: GenerateRequest, user=Depends(get_user)):
    """Generate an image from a text prompt."""
    # Check billing limits
    can, reason = billing.can_generate(user["id"])
    if not can:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail=reason)

    # Enhance the prompt
    enhanced = prompt_engine.enhance(
        req.prompt, style=req.style, aspect=req.aspect
    )

    # Check resolution limit for user's tier
    tier = billing.TIERS[user["tier"]]
    max_res = tier["max_resolution"]
    width = min(enhanced["width"], max_res)
    height = min(enhanced["height"], max_res)

    # Generate the image
    try:
        result = await image_service.generate(
            prompt=enhanced["prompt"],
            negative_prompt=enhanced["negative_prompt"],
            width=width,
            height=height
        )
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Generation failed: {e}")

    # Record billing
    billing.record_generation(
        user["id"], req.prompt, result["cost"], f"{width}x{height}"
    )

    return GenerateResponse(
        id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
        image_url=result.get("image_url"),
        image_base64=result.get("image_base64"),
        enhanced_prompt=enhanced["prompt"],
        style=req.style,
        resolution=f"{width}x{height}",
        generation_time=result["generation_time"],
        cost=result["cost"]
    )

@app.get("/api/health")
async def health():
    return {"status": "ok", "provider": settings.IMAGE_PROVIDER}

"""
Production rate limiting for PixelForge.
Three tiers: in-memory (development), Redis (production), token bucket (advanced).
"""
import time
from collections import defaultdict

# === TIER 1: In-Memory Rate Limiter (Development) ===
class InMemoryRateLimiter:
    """Simple sliding window rate limiter. Works for single-server setup."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.requests = defaultdict(list)

    def is_allowed(self, key, max_requests, window_seconds):
        """Check if request is allowed under the rate limit."""
        now = time.time()
        window_start = now - window_seconds

        # Clean old entries
        self.requests[key] = [t for t in self.requests[key] if t > window_start]

        if len(self.requests[key]) >= max_requests:
            retry_after = self.requests[key][0] - window_start
            return False, {{
                "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
                "limit": max_requests,
                "window": window_seconds,
                "retry_after": round(retry_after, 1),
                "current": len(self.requests[key])
            }}

        self.requests[key].append(now)
        return True, {{
            "remaining": max_requests - len(self.requests[key]),
            "limit": max_requests,
            "reset": round(window_start + window_seconds - now, 1)
        }}

# === TIER 2: Redis Rate Limiter (Production) ===
class RedisRateLimiter:
    """Redis-based rate limiter for distributed deployments.

    In production, install: pip install redis
    And use a real Redis connection.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        # In production: self.redis = redis.Redis(host='redis', port=6379, db=0)
        self.memory = defaultdict(list)  # Simulating Redis

    def check_rate_limit(self, user_id, tier="free"):
        """Check rate limit based on user tier."""
        limits = {{
            "free":       {{"requests_per_minute": 5,  "requests_per_day": 50}},
            "starter":    {{"requests_per_minute": 20, "requests_per_day": 500}},
            "pro":        {{"requests_per_minute": 60, "requests_per_day": 5000}},
            "enterprise": {{"requests_per_minute": 200, "requests_per_day": 50000}},
        }}

        tier_limits = limits.get(tier, limits["free"])
        now = time.time()

        # Check per-minute limit
        minute_key = f"rate:{{user_id}}:minute"
        self.memory[minute_key] = [t for t in self.memory[minute_key] if t > now - 60]

        if len(self.memory[minute_key]) >= tier_limits["requests_per_minute"]:
            return False, {{
                "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
                "type": "per_minute",
                "limit": tier_limits["requests_per_minute"],
                "retry_after_seconds": 60 - (now - self.memory[minute_key][0])
            }}

        # Check per-day limit
        day_key = f"rate:{{user_id}}:day"
        self.memory[day_key] = [t for t in self.memory[day_key] if t > now - 86400]

        if len(self.memory[day_key]) >= tier_limits["requests_per_day"]:
            return False, {{
                "error": "daily_limit_exceeded",
                "type": "per_day",
                "limit": tier_limits["requests_per_day"],
            }}

        # Allow request
        self.memory[minute_key].append(now)
        self.memory[day_key].append(now)

        return True, {{
            "remaining_minute": tier_limits["requests_per_minute"] - len(self.memory[minute_key]),
            "remaining_day": tier_limits["requests_per_day"] - len(self.memory[day_key]),
        }}

# === FastAPI Middleware ===
class RateLimitMiddleware:
    """
    FastAPI middleware for rate limiting.

    Usage in your app:
        from rate_limiter import RateLimitMiddleware
        app.add_middleware(RateLimitMiddleware)

    Or as a dependency:
        @app.get("/generate")
        async def generate(rate_limit: dict = Depends(check_rate_limit)):
            ...
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.limiter = RedisRateLimiter()

    def get_middleware_code(self):
        """Print the actual FastAPI middleware code."""
        code = "# Add to your FastAPI app:\\n\\n"
        code += "from fastapi import Request, Response\\n"
        code += "from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware\\n\\n"
        code += "class RateLimitMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):\\n"
        code += "    async def dispatch(self, request, call_next):\\n"
        code += "        api_key = request.headers.get('X-API-Key', 'anonymous')\\n"
        code += "        user_id = self.get_user_from_key(api_key)\\n"
        code += "        tier = self.get_user_tier(user_id)\\n"
        code += "        allowed, info = self.limiter.check_rate_limit(user_id, tier)\\n"
        code += "        if not allowed:\\n"
        code += "            return JSONResponse(status_code=429, content=info)\\n"
        code += "        response = await call_next(request)\\n"
        code += "        response.headers['X-RateLimit-Remaining'] = str(info.get('remaining_minute', 0))\\n"
        code += "        return response\\n"
        print(code)


# --- Demo ---
print("=== Rate Limiting Demo for PixelForge ===\\n")

limiter = RedisRateLimiter()

# Simulate requests from different users
users = [
    ("user_free_1", "free"),
    ("user_pro_1", "pro"),
    ("user_enterprise_1", "enterprise"),
]

for user_id, tier in users:
    print(f"User: {{user_id}} ({{tier}} tier)")
    for i in range(8):
        allowed, info = limiter.check_rate_limit(user_id, tier)
        status = "ALLOWED" if allowed else "BLOCKED"
        print(f"  Request {{i+1}}: {{status}} | {{info}}")
        if not allowed:
            break
    print()

# Show middleware code
mw = RateLimitMiddleware()
mw.get_middleware_code()
